## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-juan Míng Chán anthology compiled by [如巹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A6%82%E5%B7%B9) Rújǐn, selecting what the compiler judged to be the orthodox-line (*zhèngmài* 正脉) transmission material from the earlier Chán lamp records and recorded-sayings literature. Effectively a curated Línjì-orthodox reader aimed at Míng practitioners.

**Abstract**

Rújǐn's selections privilege the Bodhidharma-to-[慧能](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E8%83%BD) Huìnéng main transmission, the Línjì 臨濟 line, and (within Línjì) the Yángqí — [宗杲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E6%9D%B2) Dàhuì — [法演](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%BC%94) Wǔzǔ Fǎyǎn 五祖法演 branch. The work is typical of late-fifteenth-century Míng Chán editorial practice: conservative in its choice of source material, orthodox in its lineage claims, pedagogical in its selection of the most-quoted recorded dialogues. As an anthology rather than a genealogical compilation in the lamp-record sense, it is catalogued separately in the Chán-literature sections of the Xuzangjing.
